title: B.A.T.M.A.N. Advanced: Update return values for unsigned
description:
When using unsigned offsets, replace the use of -1 as a "stop
dissecting" sentinel with tvb_reported_length(tvb). Using zero
for both the start offset and the stop sentinel makes the while
loops never be entered.

Coverity 1695334, 1695338, 1695313, & 1695347

Fixup f7461969ff2664debf17b5ac96ffbadf3be86c7c
